sources.title: Building for a Healthy Life
sources.facts: Introduces the updated 12-principle toolkit for neighbourhoods, streets, homes and public spaces.
sources.guard: A toolkit score does not prove planning compliance, delivery quality or resident outcomes.

sources.title: Building for a Healthy Life 2026 HTML
sources.facts: Provides detailed design prompts for connected places, movement, landscape, streets and stewardship.
sources.guard: Illustrated guidance does not prove a scheme is viable, built or well managed.

sources.title: Healthy Homes
sources.facts: Provides core specifications and good practice for healthier and resilient homes.
sources.guard: Good-practice specifications do not prove a design meets every requirement or is constructed correctly.

sources.title: National design guide
sources.facts: Sets characteristics of well-designed places and examples of good design.
sources.guard: National guidance does not determine site-specific character, acceptability or consent.

sources.title: National Model Design Code
sources.facts: Provides detailed guidance for preparing design codes, guides and policies.
sources.guard: A model code does not itself create binding local requirements or approve a scheme.

sources.title: Design: process and tools
sources.facts: Explains design codes, masterplans, review and tools within planning.
sources.guard: Process guidance does not prove engagement quality, code adoption or design compliance.

sources.title: NPPF: achieving well-designed places
sources.facts: Sets expectations for high-quality, sustainable, inclusive and accessible places.
sources.guard: National expectations do not establish that a specific proposal is acceptable.

sources.title: Design and Placemaking Planning Practice Guidance consultation
sources.facts: Consults on draft consolidated guidance for well-designed places and design codes.
sources.guard: A consultation draft is not final policy and must not be treated as adopted guidance.
